items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1975-05-15
items.q: Like when I was playing with Carl Basie.

ctx.x: Did you feel comfortable with them? Yes.

You know, I hated to leave those guys. I hated to leave those guys. I hated to leave those guys. I hated to leave those guys. I hated them so many years. I do it my way. You do it your way. And it doesn't go that way. If they were playing with any major band, you have to play the way you want. The arrangement called. Like when I was playing with Carl Basie. He had a hit arrangement on. I mean a hit record on. I said, I can't stop loving you. I played with Ray Charles for two years before that. He had also had a…
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. I suppose you had a first base when you said, well you guys play baseball. You're well played my way. But what happened to the team? It's the same thing to me.
